title: Container With Most Water
prompt: You are given an integer array `height` where `height[i]` is the height of a vertical line at position `i`. Find two lines that, together with the x-axis, form a container that holds the most water. Return the maximum area.
hints: A brute-force check of every pair is O(n^2) — think about a two-pointer approach from both ends.
The area is limited by the shorter of the two lines, so moving the taller pointer inward can never help.
Always move the pointer at the shorter line inward, tracking the max area seen as you go.
